_about: Final-election pre-2025 demographic polling stores. Lanes scrape sources into lanes/*.json (schema below); build-stores.mjs merges them into data/demographics-<year>-election.json mirroring the 2025 store's shape. src/<lane>/ keeps verbatim evidence copies.

waves.dateStart: fieldwork start YYYY-MM-DD (null if only a publication date exists)
waves.date: fieldwork end YYYY-MM-DD, else publication date
